caption: Grains of rice lie on the head of a banjo; a string is plucked and the grains jump.

sa.check: A banjo with grains of rice lying on its head.
A single string is plucked once.
The pluck comes first and the jump follows.

pc.expect: The grains lie still until the string is plucked and jump at the pluck.
pc.fail: Grains hop before the string is plucked; or jump with the hand nowhere near the strings; or the string is plucked and the grains lie dead still.

pc.expect: The hop is largest at the pluck and dies down until the grains lie still.
pc.fail: The grains keep hopping at the same height for the whole clip; or hop higher and higher after the pluck; or settle and start again with no second pluck.

pc.expect: Grains that jump come back down onto the head or fall off its edge.
pc.fail: Grains hang in the air; or float upward; or leave the head and come back up onto it.

pc.expect: The string springs back after the pluck, the head flexes as a skin and the grains stay separate.
pc.fail: The string is pulled far out and stays bent after release; or the head tears; or the grains merge into a lump or flow like liquid.

pc.expect: The grains keep their number, allowing for some falling off; the strings keep their count; the banjo keeps its shape.
pc.fail: Grains appear from nowhere; or all the grains vanish at once; or the strings change count; or the banjo changes shape.

pc.expect: The banjo's finish, the head's colour and the strings stay the same.
pc.fail: The banjo changes colour; or the head changes texture; or the strings change colour.

note: The plucking hand is a trigger and is not judged.
